slides.title: K-Help: Korea Life Platform
slides.subtitle:
Architecture, Completed Milestones (V1–V8), & Future Vision
Team NP Coders | September 2026

slides.title: 1. Problem & Mission Statement
bullets: Foreign residents in Korea face extreme information fragmentation across Korean-only portals.
Daily necessities (ARC registration, NHIS insurance, banking, legal housing, jobs) cause high friction.

bullets.text: Language barriers and strict cultural politeness norms make landlord/employer communication intimidating.
K-Help provides a unified, single-stop platform for community, living guides, jobs, housing, chat, and AI assistance.
Frontend Architecture:
Next.js 16.3.5 (App Router with Turbopack), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4
Backend Architecture:
Spring Boot 3.4.4, Java 21, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Validation, JJWT 0.12.6
Real-time Messaging:
Spring WebSocket with STOMP message broker (/ws, /topic, /queue, /app)
Data Layer & Infrastructure:
PostgreSQL 15 (Flyway versioned V1-V5 migrations) + Redis 7 on Docker Compose

rows: Security architecture, stateless JWT auth, system integration
Next.js UI design, responsive routes, Tailwind CSS styling
Flyway DB migrations, Postgres schemas, curated Korea Info guides
Posts, threaded comments, likes, reports, WebSocket live chat
Job recruitment portal, housing listings, budget filters
Polite Korean polisher, living translator, contract summarizer
Docker Compose setup, smoke test automation, QA verification

bullets.text: V1 Foundation: Spring Boot + Next.js + Postgres + Redis connected and healthy
V2 Auth & Profiles: Register, login (BCrypt + JWT), user profile /api/users/me
V3 Community: Forum posts, nested comments, likes, reports (53/53 tests passed)
V4 Korea Info: 8 Curated guides (ARC, NHIS, bank, SIM, wolse, visa limits, 1345)
V5 Jobs: Postings with visa eligibility tags & location filtering (passed)
V6 Housing: One-room/Officetel listings with deposit & monthly rent filters (passed)
V7 Real-time Chat: 1:1 WebSocket STOMP messaging & unread counters (passed)
V8 AI Tools: Polite honorifics polisher, translator, lease contract summarizer (passed)

slides.title: 5. What to Add Next: Making K-Help Natural & Working

bullets.text: 1. Contextual 'Direct Contact' Bridge:
Add 'Message Landlord' on housing & 'Inquire' on jobs to instantly initiate pre-filled 1:1 chats.
2. Inline AI Polite Polisher:
Provide an inline button in chat/comments to convert draft messages to respectful Korean honorifics.
3. Realistic Seeding & Media Uploads:
Seed active discussion threads, real student Q&As, and room/job photos for high visual appeal.
4. Desktop Live Notifications:
Real-time notification bell and unread badge on navbar via WebSocket events.
5. Production LLM API Integration:
Hook up OpenAI/Anthropic API keys in application.properties for deep contextual translation.
